definitions.explanation: A person who has a lot of money.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{金持|かねも}ちだ。
{金持|かねも}ちになっても、{幸|しあわ}せとは{限|かぎ}らない。
examples.english: Even if you become rich, it doesn't necessarily mean you'll be happy.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{金持|かねも}ちだけど、とても{優|やさ}しい{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He's wealthy, but he's a very kind person.

notes:
{金持|かねも}ち is the most common everyday word for a rich or wealthy person. It can function as both a noun and a na-adjective.

WORD FORMATION:
{金|かね} (money) + {持|も}ち (having, from {持|も}つ). Literally "one who has money."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {金持|かねも}ちになる: to become rich
- お{金持|かねも}ち: rich person (polite or playful)
- {大金持|おおがねも}ち: very rich person
- {金持|かねも}ちの{家|いえ}: a wealthy person's house

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裕福|ゆうふく}: wealthy, well-off (na-adjective, slightly formal)
- {富裕層|ふゆうそう}: the wealthy class (formal, statistical contexts)
- {資産家|しさんか}: person of wealth, property owner (formal)

OPPOSITE:
- {貧乏|びんぼう}: poor
